pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal shapes with predominantly rounded vertices and smooth pixel gradients at the boundaries. Patch size is heterogeneous, with larger, more uniform shapes on the mid-flank and smaller, more compressed geometries on the lower neck region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-tan pathways with significant pixel thickness. Intersections are primarily characterized by three-way junction nodes, creating a well-defined but non-rectilinear lattice.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the superior neck boundary. The mane exhibits a dense, high-frequency textural profile against the background with minimal variation in hair height.
